entries.text: OK... This should be about far enough.[VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_4kings_c_04_fairybb_01

entries.text: Let me properly introduce myself for this.\c\nI am Lacey of the Elite Four.[VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_4kings_c_04_fairybb_02

entries.text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]I really didn’t expect I’d get a challenge from
someone like you, [VAR 0x0100(0000)].
Rightfully,
you
do
belong
to a
different
school.[VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_4kings_c_04_fairybb_03

entries.text: Honestly, I’m still a bit shocked, but I won’t let\nmy personal feelings get in the way of our battle![VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_4kings_c_04_fairybb_04

entries.text: So, ah, let’s see. First of all, I should tell you\nI mostly use Fairy-type Pokémon.[VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_4kings_c_04_fairybb_05

entries.text: There’s just nothing like an adorable pink fairy,\nright?[VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_4kings_c_04_fairybb_06

entries.text: They’re weak to Poison and Steel. Anything too\ncaustic or cutting just doesn’t suit them.[VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_4kings_c_04_fairybb_07

entries.text: Oh, but you must know all this already, right,\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)]?[VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_4kings_c_04_fairybb_08

entries.text: Now, for this battle, I’m not going to hold\nanything back.[VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_4kings_c_04_fairybb_09

entries.text: I want to be sure you walk away with a proper\nunderstanding, after all.[VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_4kings_c_04_fairybb_10

entries.text: You’re about to learn that cuteness is real\nstrength![VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_4kings_c_04_fairybb_11

entries.text: Did you see our Pokémon battling it out?![VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_4kings_c_04_fairybb_13

entries.text: Oooh, it’s almost too much—they were just too\ncute, even for me![VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_4kings_c_04_fairybb_14

entries.text: They were super cute!
entries.label: sdc02_4kings_c_04_select_01

entries.text: They were super cool!
entries.label: sdc02_4kings_c_04_select_02

entries.text: You’re the cutest, Lacey!
entries.label: sdc02_4kings_c_04_select_03

entries.text: Hee hee! For sure! And I get the best view as a\nTrainer since I’m so close to the action![VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_4kings_c_04_fairybb_15

entries.text: Bzzzt! Nope! Wrong! We’re not talking about\nbeing cool. We’re talking about being CUTE![VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_4kings_c_04_fairybb_16

entries.text: Bzzzt! Nope! Wrong! We’re not talking about\nme. We’re talking about my POKÉMON![VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_4kings_c_04_fairybb_17

entries.text: [VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Your Pokémon were very cute as well,\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)].[VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_4kings_c_04_fairybb_18

entries.text: Phew... You know, it’s just not right for two\npeople to hog all this cuteness between them.[VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_4kings_c_04_fairybb_19

entries.text: Why don’t we wrangle up the cute Pokémon here\nfor a cute picture we can share with everyone?[VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_4kings_c_04_fairybb_20

entries.text: Oooh, this one is just too cute! I’m going to\nmake myself a backup copy or three...[VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_4kings_c_04_fairybb_21

entries.text: I’ll give you this as well, as proof of your\ncuteness.[VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_4kings_c_04_fairybb_22

entries.text: You really are very strong when you get serious\nin battle, [VAR 0x0100(0000)].[VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_4kings_c_04_fairybb_23

entries.text: I wonder how far you’ll be able to get, facing off\nagainst the strongest Trainers in our school...\r\nI’ll be keeping an eye on you and your progress![VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_4kings_c_04_fairybb_24

entries.text: Congratulations on your victory over our Miss\nLacey, the Elite Four member for this biome!
entries.label: sdc02_4kings_c_04_clerk_npc
